Subject: RE: Quarrow Roofing Submission

Hi Avery,

Thanks for thinking of us for Quarrow Roofing. Unfortunately, we'll need to pass on this one.

Roofing contractors fall outside our current appetite, and the coastal location creates additional concerns—the property sits within 16 km of the coast, and we're already heavily concentrated in that area with our existing portfolio.

Given the roofing operations and coastal exposure, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market that actively writes this class and has stronger coastal capacity.

Happy to look at other submissions that might be a better fit!

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
